call_points.text: FY27 revenue guidance of ₹7,300 Cr reiterated, with management saying it is on track.
MDO margin seen at 15-17% in FY28, reaching 21-23% only from FY29 when both mines hit peak rated capacity.
Price-variation clauses lag a quarter, so input inflation from steel, LNG and diesel is only partly recovered in the current period.
Management targets order inflows of around ₹12,000 crores for FY27.
Capex for FY27 is projected at around ₹400 crores without adding debt.
Total order backlog stands at approximately ₹55,151 crores, with an executable book excluding MDO of around ₹15,899 crores.
Overall EBITDA margin for FY27 is expected to touch 12.5%, including other income.

operating_notes.text: Secured ₹227.95 Cr order from South Western Railway for Vande Bharat Sleeper Trains Maintenance Depot at Thanisandra on EPC mode to be executed in 30 months.
Monitoring Agency Report indicates ₹286.66 crore utilized out of ₹350 crore QIP proceeds as of March 31, 2026.
FY26 consolidated operating cash flow was ₹429.80 Cr against ₹0.74 Cr in FY25, covering capex of ₹335.46 Cr.
Q4FY26 effective tax rate fell to 17.7% from 28.3% in Q4FY25, lifting PAT growth above PBT growth.
Trade receivables rose to ₹1,546.79 Cr at Mar-2026 from ₹1,349.76 Cr at Q2FY26.
FY26 operating cash flow reached ₹430 Cr compared to ₹74 lakh in FY25.
Q1FY27 revenue mix was 96% domestic and 4% international; power was 54% of revenue and non-power 46%.
Order backlog was 98.7% domestic and 1.3% international; power was 73.6% and non-power 26.4%.
Customer backlog: BHEL about ₹5,300 Cr across five projects, Adani about ₹2,400 Cr across 14 projects, Vedanta ₹1,551 Cr across six projects; average execution period about 2.5 years.
Power Mech issued a ₹469 Cr corporate guarantee for subsidiary KTMPL's loans of ₹175 Cr (RBL Bank) and ₹294 Cr (IDFC First Bank), funding coal handling plant, railway siding and R&R colony capex.
The guarantee is to be released by September 1, 2035, and is disclosed as a contingent liability with no immediate impact on the company's financial position.
Secured ₹327.35 Cr O&M contract from Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited for 48 months.

timeline.summary: Power Mech Projects secured a ₹227.95 Cr EPC order from South Western Railway for a Vande Bharat maintenance depot on April 27, 2026.
Power Mech Projects filed its Q4FY26 Monitoring Agency Report showing ₹286.66 crore utilised out of ₹350 crore QIP proceeds.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,110.73 Cr (+13.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹142.55 Cr (+21.6% YoY).
Power Mech Projects promoters submitted zero share encumbrance declaration under Regulation 31(4) for FY26.
Power Mech Projects reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹2,121 Cr (+13% YoY) and PAT of ₹153 Cr (+18% YoY).
Power Mech Projects secured a ₹266.26 Cr O&M contract from Adani Infrastructure Management Services on June 3, 2026.
On its 10 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, Power Mech reported revenue of ₹1,632 Cr (+26% YoY) with EBITDA down 3% at a 10.8% margin, and reiterated its 12.5% FY27 margin and ₹12,000 Cr order inflow targets.
Power Mech issued a ₹469 Cr corporate guarantee for subsidiary Kalyaneswari Tasra Mining's project-capex loans from RBL Bank (₹175 Cr) and IDFC First Bank (₹294 Cr), releasable by September 1, 2035.
Power Mech Projects bagged a ₹327.35 crore O&M contract from Vedanta Aluminium Metal on October 19, 2026.
